# Or step by step manually:
gcc -E hello.c -o hello.i      # preprocess only
gcc -S hello.i -o hello.s      # compile to assembly
gcc -c hello.s -o hello.o      # assemble to object file
gcc hello.o -o hello           # link to executable
description: These commands separate preprocessing, compilation, assembly, and linking.

steps.description: The first commands preprocess C source and compile the result to assembly.
The -c flag assembles the assembly file into an object file without linking.
The final command links the object file into an executable.

title: Run each compiler stage
